curation.notes: LUMICKS C-Trap dual-trap optical tweezers with two-colour confocal fluorescence: a 12.3-kbp RNA–DNA hybrid (RDH) tethered between streptavidin beads is exposed to EXD2-eGFP (human EXD2 61–621) to follow binding, digestion under tension, and co-condensation at low force; Cy3-labeled yeast RNase H1 is used to introduce RNA nicks/gaps. Cell imaging (HeLa) complements the single-molecule work.

evidence.snippet: Single-molecule optical-tweezer assays were performed at 25°C on an instrument combining two-colour confocal fluorescence microscopy with dual optical traps (LUMICKS C-trap, Netherlands).
The trap stiffness was typically set around 0.6 pN/nm and calibrated by measuring the effect of the optical trap on the Brownian motion of the trapped microsphere [37].
For EXD2-eGFP imaging, a 488 nm excitation laser was employed, the confocal pixel size was set at 75 nm, and the pixel dwell time was 50 ms.
an RDH molecule was initially captured between two streptavidin-coated polystyrene beads (1.76 μm in diameter, Spherotech).

pulling_speed.note: RDH relaxation/stretching assays; force-extension characterisation at 0.2 μm/s (200 nm/s)

evidence.snippet: In the RDH relaxation and stretching assays, the RDH was stretched at a constant rate of 0.1 μm/s [37, 38].

entities.name: RNA–DNA hybrid (12.3 kbp, lambda-derived, biotinylated ssDNA strand; intact, nicked or gapped)

evidence.snippet: The template typically consists of a two-sided biotinylated single-stranded (ss)DNA and a paired ssRNA. A dsDNA segment was PCR-amplified from the lambda DNA
Recombinant EXD2 (61–621) was used for protein expression because of its improved solubility and yield [21, 33]. The EXD2 gene was amplified by PCR using Homo sapiens complementary DNA as a template

entities.name: Yeast RNase H1 (LPETG-tagged, Cy3-labeled via sortase A)

evidence.snippet: The plasmid designed for the expression of Yeast RNase H1 was constructed by synthesizing open reading frames and integrating them into pET28a [34, 35].

Unless otherwise specified, all experiments were performed in a reaction buffer containing 25 mM Tris–HCl (pH 7.5), 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM MnCl2, 0.05 mg/ml bovine serum albumin (BSA), and 1 mM dithiothreitol (DTT).
